hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE "(long_lived_access_token|token.*revok|token.*rotat|token.*regenerat|auth/token)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Do not create, rotate, or revoke HA tokens. See CLAUDE.md token rules." >&2; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "\.env$"; then echo "WARNING: You are editing .env — ensure you are NOT modifying HA_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unless the user explicitly requested it." >&2; fi'
